description: Change an existing automation: its actions, conditions, trigger config or name, or switch it off with isActive false. Fields left out stay as they are; actions and conditions, when given, replace the whole list. Use it to fix an automation instead of creating a second one next to it. Get the id from list_automations. A scheduled automation can run once per occurrence with no row instead of once per row: triggerConfig { cron, timezone, perBoard: true }, see create_automation. For send_email actions, config.kind is transactional (default) or marketing (Pro plan or higher, verified sender domain, unsubscribe footer) and config.attachments is an array of file column ids on the row; see create_automation.

actions.description: The full new list of actions (replaces the old one)

config.description: Action-specific config, same shapes as in create_automation (send_email takes relatedRows and skipIfAllEmpty there too)

boardId.description: Board id the automation belongs to

conditions.description: Run only for rows that match, e.g. [{ field: "<column id>", operator: "equals", value: "New seller" }]

field.description: A column id on this board (from get_board_schema), or status, priority, title

operator.description: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, is_empty, is_not_empty, greater_than, less_than

isActive.description: false switches it off, true on

triggerConfig.description: New trigger config, same shape as in create_automation (scheduled: { cron, timezone, perBoard } with a 5-field cron and an IANA zone, default Asia/Jerusalem, or the older { intervalHours, runAtHour in UTC }). It replaces the old trigger config as a whole, so repeat cron, timezone and perBoard. perBoard: true needs no conditions and only send_email (fixed addresses), http_request (no responseMapping) and send_webhook as actions, so change the actions in the same call

name: update_automation
